raw_text: The Maldives has signed a military cooperation agreement with China, raising alarm bells in New Delhi. The deal includes provisions for joint naval exercises, a Chinese-funded coast guard facility on Marao atoll, and the deployment of Chinese technical advisors. The agreement comes in the wake of the 'India Out' campaign that led to the withdrawal of Indian military personnel from the island nation. Indian strategic analysts warn this could give China a foothold in India's southern maritime flank, completing an encirclement strategy in the Indian Ocean.
clean_text: Maldives signed China military deal with joint exercises, coast guard facility on Marao, and Chinese advisors. India alarmed by potential Chinese foothold in southern maritime flank.
